Universal: total 2,261,420; administration fee 10% on airport/government fees and third-party ramp transportation. Lavatory, water and trash included (0); CIQ arrangements and slot coordination included in the permit/CIQ paperwork coordination fee. Air Contrail: total 2,812,170 incl. catering 400,000 + 15%; handling fee includes marshalling, wing watch, chocks, one towing, one pushback, one lavatory and one potable water service, trash on arrival and departure, two slot and two parking spot coordinations, baggage handling, escort and supervision. Admin charge 15% on third-party charges (airport fees, crew transportation); third-party amounts are approximate. Navigation fees depend on distance: 165,000 arrival from OMAD and 91,000 departure to OMDW (Universal), entered for Air Contrail too. Business jet terminal facility fee 880,000 for arrival and departure (440,000 each). NACCS 6,000 per movement × 2. Surcharge: ETA or ETD 11:00Z–23:00Z (20:00–08:00 L) 20% of ground handling, both 30%.
